reviews.title: Find another option
reviews.text: Small businesses count on accurate timekeeping and daily efficiency. If you choose Homebase expect frequent bugs, unreliable and inconvenient updates, and a frustrating experience with their Ai Assistant. Highly suggest looking elsewhere for timekeeping, scheduling, hiring, and other business needs. After 5+ years with Homebase it has consistently gotten worse with each passing week.

reviews.title: It’s trash.
reviews.text:
Terrible, vibe-coded software that barely functions. The page for looking at submitted off-requests and availability changes flat out does not function right now. You can click a request and it will pull up the wrong one, the SAME wrong one, for every click. 

Live Actions integration also does not work. The notifications do not go away when the break is over and finished via the POS system. They don’t go away after you clock out. It can only correctly process breaks processed through the app alone. Why even have this feature at all if you aren’t going to finish it? 

Also, cash out is a scam. Homebase does not deserve to exist and CERTAINLY does not deserve to charge money for their abysmal product. 

Fire your entire dev team.

reviews.title: Misleading Free Tier
reviews.text: The free tier is misleading, and you don’t find out until after you’ve already signed up, set up everything in the app, and the free trial runs out. The free tier is supposedly “free for up to 10 employees”, and they advertise “basic time tracking” as included in the free tier. They make it look like the app is part of the free tier, but it’s really not, at least not in any meaningful way. It even says above that you can use the time clock from any phone or tablet. HOWEVER, the time clock is NOT available in the app on the free tier. It is only available on the web or tablet, which doesn’t work for my setup. I literally only have ONE employee and need the app to allow this employee to clock in and out, that’s it! And the free tier won’t even let me do that. Very misleading advertising about the free tier. I would be willing to pay a one time fee for use of the app, but I’m not paying $30 each month for basic clock in/out service.

reviews.title: Changing plans requiring upgrades
reviews.text: I was happy with the basic plan of Homebase for nearly 2 years, until the change from the basic plan supporting 20 employees to now only 10. Support was not helpful besides offering the Essentials plan moving forward. Our organization will be moving to a different platform going forward.

reviews.title: GARBAGE APP
reviews.text: This has to be created by the same people that created cubicles. Having to conform I mean confirm EVERY ACTION has been a nightmare! It has resulted in missed paychecks, missed clock ins, outs and mealtimes. Not to mention the annual cost. It only wants me to take 30 minute lunches then brow beats me every minute until I clock back in but you have to be at the shop if I’m in the field there’s no recourse for that creating more work for everyone else.

reviews.title: Much better options to help you run your business!
reviews.text: Support was extremely slow and not helpful. At all. The lay out could be much more clear and organized. It feels like there’s 10 folders within a section, but there’s also more sections within those. For what it has to offer, there’s more dynamic options that also allow you to write your schedule in app and even compare sales and see them real time. We considered home base as an option, created accounts to test it out, and it’s been extremely difficult to delete and edit our accounts. (As in delete them bc we don’t need them) Boo Homebase.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Stay away from this app. They constantly changing stuff, leaving functions out that you're use too, as of now can't see even employees hours on decimal time or industrial time format. They just took it out with a new update just like that.

reviews.title: Great for team communication TERRIBLE for tax reporting!
reviews.text: I own a business with approximately 45 employees. In our state our Workers Compensation reporting is done at the beginning of the quarter. Even after our CPA explained this to, Homebase doesn’t file the reports correctly or pay the withholdings on time. Ever. We have contacted them over and over and they will not let us talk to anyone in the “Tax” department. We have now  received several collection letters. We have had to double pay  the withholding just to get it taken care of and when reporting the issue to Homebase they tell us we will have to ask for the refund from the State even though they still hadn’t paid the overdue payment. We are switching payroll companies this month.

reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.text:
I used to love Homebase! It was always very simple to use, never had any issues with logging in, or passwords or anything! Now it logs me out every time I close the app in the last month I have had to physically go in an update it 4 times and my apps are set for auto updates! 
Also in the last month my password has not worked and I have had to change it almost every single time I have tried to log in! 
I work over 90 hrs for one job - my schedule is usually pretty sporadic through out the day and to have to literally log in every single time and then change passwords because the system is not recognizing my password - when I know it is correct and I have had my biometrics (fingerprint & and face set up) makes absolutely no sense to how I am having so many issues! 

What ever updates being pushed through need to be unpushed and go back to the software it was prior to 3 months ago!

reviews.title: Do NOT have two jobs on here
reviews.text:
Been using this app for a while with one job and it worked just fine. Recently got a second job that uses the same app, but wasn’t able to set a separate availability for Job #2. 

Support wasn’t helpful at all. Turns out you’re only allowed to have ONE availability schedule even if you have multiple jobs/locations on the app/website so someone’s always going to have the incorrect availability. According to them, there is no workaround to add location-specific availability, which seems ABSURD since they advertise usability with multiple locations and it lets me switch between jobs in the app/website already. It even lets me select who the availability is for, but it still syncs globally. This should ALREADY be a feature. Please fix this ASAP.

reviews.title: AI sellouts who don’t care about the people who use their product
reviews.text: Forced you to waste your time and chat with a support AI only to not adequately pair you with support. It seems the app has no formal process to report bugs with the UI seperate from any complaints, they recently must have needed money for their new AI so they took away features they previously had like the daily agenda layout for the daily schedule on IPhone, app constantly glitches and will tell people they are in the wrong location and can’t clock in thus looking money and wasting the companies time as employees have to seek out a manager in the facility just to clock in, it’s been auto logging people out leading to the same issue of people just standing around on the salesfloor for up to 10 mins trying to get the “homebase wheel of death” to load (and yes it just pops up again or logs you out if you close and re-open the app), mixing up or just straight up deleting profile pictures, and now mixing up request for other companies, as when a terminated employee gets a new job and they use homebase, it will  start to share that new data with the old profile. Don’t worry they will do nothing to help. Don’t use unless your company makes you. As a hourly employee, it will do the job, but from the perspective of the managers who selected this app for scheduling. It has a LOT of improvements and possible security breaches that make me uncomfortable recommending it.
